concept: Deployment: blue/green for minimal risk and fast rollback
tests: Choosing a deployment strategy where the old version keeps running until the new one is verified.
expected: Blue/green deployment: the new version (green) runs alongside the old one (blue), traffic switches after verification, fast rollback. Triggers: "keeping the previous version running until the new one is verified", "minimizing risk".
why_not: Updating everything in place at once risks a full outage; stopping instances or recreating the ASG causes downtime.
